Good to know

Exchange & delivery

Exchange policy
  • Exchanges within 7 days of purchase or delivery, with the receipt or order number.
  • Items must be unworn, unwashed, with original tags attached.
  • Exchange for another size, another item, or store credit. We don't give cash refunds.
  • Sale items, jewellery, and altered or custom-stitched pieces can't be exchanged.
  • If a piece arrives damaged or wrong, message us within 48 hours and we'll replace it free.
Delivery
  • Karachi: 1–3 working days. Other cities: 3–5 working days.
  • Cash on delivery across Pakistan. Bank transfer also accepted.
  • Delivery charges are confirmed on WhatsApp before we dispatch.
  • We confirm every order by phone or WhatsApp before it ships.
  • Prefer to try first? Collect from the store, Mon–Sat, 12 pm – 9 pm.
